__Vulcan Power Armour Stats__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_aae17018bd5641ab95ed9c103bf1b843~mv2.png)

Base Stats

- 42% Damage Reduction: Standard for all Power Armor, with 7% per equipped piece (up to 42% total).
- 90% Radiation Damage Reduction: Standard for all Power Armor, with 15% per equipped piece (up to 90% total).
- Immunity to Fall Damage
- Immunity to Limb Damage
- Increased Strength: Boosts Strength up to a maximum of 11 if below 11.
- +25% AP Regen Rate: Unique Set Bonus.
- +25% Fusion Core Duration: Unique Set Bonus

__How to Obtain Vulcan Power Armour and Crafting Plans__

To obtain a full set of Vulcan Power Armour and its crafting plans, you’ll need to complete the Gleaming Depths Raids. There’s a 5% chance per stage (or 22% per full raid) for a plan to drop.

Once you’ve learned all the power armour plans, they’ll stop dropping—until you’ve also learned all the mod plans. At that point, the plans will reset and begin dropping again. These plans are non-tradeable. There are a total of 6 plans to be obtained to be able to craft a full set of Vulcan Power Armour.

- Plan: Vulcan Helmet
- Plan: Vulcan Left Arm
- Plan: Vulcan Left Leg
- Plan: Vulcan Right Arm
- Plan: Vulcan Right Leg
- Plan: Vulcan Torso

You can find the Reward Checklist to mark off the plans as they drop __here__.

### **__Vulcan Power Armour Mods__**

__Vulcan Power Armour Mods__

Mods can be used to customize and enhance your Vulcan Power Armour. Both the power armour plans and mod plans can drop independently, meaning you don’t need to learn all the Vulcan Power Armour plans before mod plans begin to drop. There are a total of 33 mod plans available for the Vulcan Power Armour.

__Vulcan Power Armour Mods Stats__

Note: When the Power Armour mod mentions Unarmed, it specifically refers to using the bare fists of the Power Armor suit itself, not any separate unarmed weapons.

**Stacks with Similar Perks and Mods Key:**

- Yes – This mod stacks with similar perks and mods.
- No – This mod does not stack with similar perks and mods.
- N/A – The mod is either unique and has nothing similar to stack with, or it does stack with another effect but does not provide additional benefits or boosts beyond what’s already given.

__Helmet__

**No Misc Mod**

- **Plan** : Known by default
- **Effect** : -
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : This is the default helmet with no added effects or upgrades. It provides basic protection but doesn’t offer any bonuses.

**Internal Database**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Internal Database
- **Effect** : +2 Intelligence
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : This mod increases your Intelligence by 2 points, which helps earn more experience points (XP). It stacks with other Intelligence-boosting perks or mods.

**Sensor Array**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Sensor Array
- **Effect** : +2 Perception
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : This mod increases Perception by 2 points, improving accuracy and spotting enemies from farther away on your HUD. It stacks with other Perception-enhancing perks and mods.

**Targeting HUD**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Targeting HUD
- **Effect** : Highlights living, hostile NPCs
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Highlights hostile NPCs in your field of view, similar to Berry Mentats but without the ability to see through walls. It does not work on cloaked or invisible enemies.

**Recon Sensors**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Recon Sensors
- **Effect** : Marks enemies with a marker when aiming
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : Adds a triangle marker on enemies when aiming through your sights. The marker remains visible until the enemy is killed, aiding in target tracking.

**VATS Matrix Overlay**

- **Plan** : Vulcan VATS Matrix Overlay
- **Effect** : +10% VATS hit chance
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Increases VATS hit chance by 10%. Works with VATS-enhanced weapons, stacking with their bonuses to improve hit accuracy further.

**Headlamp Red Tactical**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Headlamp Red Tactical
- **Effect** : Adds a red tactical headlamp
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : This modification equips your Vulcan Power Armour helmet with a bold, tactical red headlamp.

**Headlamp Blue**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Headlamp Blue
- **Effect** : Adds a blue headlamp
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : This mod adds a cool, calming blue light to your Power Armour helmet, offering a stylish alternative to traditional headlamp colors while keeping the wasteland illuminated.

**Headlamp Bright**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Headlamp Bright
- **Effect** : Adds an extra bright headlamp
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : Enhances visibility by equipping a brighter headlamp for your Power Armour helmet.

**Headlamp Purple**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Headlamp Purple
- **Effect** : Adds a purple headlamp
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : An aesthetic modification providing purple lighting for the Power Armour helmet.

**Headlamp Vault Boy**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Headlamp Vault Boy
- **Effect** : Adds a Vault Boy-themed headlamp
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : This unique headlamp projects an iconic Vault Boy image wherever you look, combining functionality with a touch of Vault-Tec nostalgia.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

__Arms__

**No Misc Mod**

- **Plan** : Known by default
- **Effect** : -
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : These are the default arms with no added effects or modifications. They provide basic protection without any bonuses.

**Hydraulic Bracers**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Hydraulic Bracers
- **Effect** : +15% unarmed damage
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : This mod increases unarmed Power Armour punch damage by 15%. When equipped on both arms, the effect stacks, providing a total of 30% more unarmed damage.

**Gimbal Bracers**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Gimbal Bracers
- **Effect** : Decreases cone of fire by 50%
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : This mod reduces the spread of your weapon’s cone of fire by 50%, improving accuracy during rapid or sustained fire.

**Optimized Bracers**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Optimized Bracers
- **Effect** : Reduces power attack AP cost by 25%
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Reduces the Action Point (AP) cost of power attacks by 25%, making them more efficient. This mod pairs well with perks or mods that further reduce AP usage.

**Rusty Knuckles**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Rusty Knuckles
- **Effect** : Adds 9 bleeding damage over 3 seconds per arm
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Causes unarmed Power Armour punches to inflict 9 points of bleeding damage over 3 seconds. When equipped on both arms, the bleeding damage stacks, dealing a total of 18 points per punch.

**Tesla Bracers**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Tesla Bracers
- **Effect** : +45 Energy damage
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Adds 45 points of Energy damage to unarmed Power Armour punches. When equipped on both arms, the effect stacks, dealing a total of 90 points of Energy damage per punch.

**Ultracite Bracers**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Ultracite Bracers
- **Effect** : Melee attacks apply poison and radiation damage on contact (25 poison and 25 radiation per second for 10 seconds)
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : This mod inflicts poison and radiation damage on melee attacks, dealing a total of 250 poison and 250 radiation damage over 10 seconds.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

__Torso__

**No Misc Mod**

- **Plan** : Known by default
- **Effect** : -
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : This is the default torso without any added effects or modifications. It provides standard protection but no bonuses.

**Blood Cleanser**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Blood Cleanser
- **Effect** : -50% addiction chance
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Reduces your chance of becoming addicted to chems by 50%. It works alongside the Chem Resistant perk card, with each roll calculated separately to reduce addiction risk.

**Core Assembly**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Core Assembly
- **Effect** : +6% AP regeneration
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Boosts the rate at which your Action Points (AP) regenerate by 6% per second. This mod works well with other AP regeneration perks or mods, helping you recover AP faster during combat or movement.

**Emergency Protocols**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Emergency Protocols
- **Effect** : +25% movement speed and -50% incoming damage when health drops below 20%
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : When your health drops below 20%, this mod increases movement speed by 25% and reduces incoming damage by 50%. Speed boosts can stack with other perks and mods but are capped at +20% total speed.

**Jet Pack**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Jet Pack
- **Effect** : -
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : Allows you to jump higher using a jet-assisted boost, making it easier to reach high places or move quickly across the battlefield.

**Kinetic Dynamo**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Kinetic Dynamo
- **Effect** : Converts 20% of damage taken into AP
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : Converts 20% of incoming damage into Action Points (AP), allowing you to recover AP as you take hits. The damage you take is unaffected, but the AP regeneration helps maintain your abilities.

**Medic Pump**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Medic Pump
- **Effect** : Automatically uses a Stimpak when health drops
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Automatically triggers a Stimpak when your health falls below 50%. Compatible with Regular, Super, and Diluted Stimpaks, and has no cooldown, healing continuously as long as you have Stimpaks in your inventory.

**Motion-Assist Servos**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Motion-Assist Servos
- **Effect** : +2 Strength
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Increases Strength by 2 points, boosting melee damage and carry weight. Works well with other Strength-enhancing perks and mods.

**Reactive Plates**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Reactive Plates
- **Effect** : Reflects 50% of melee damage back on the attacker
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Reflects 50% of melee damage received back onto the attacker. It stacks with the Riposting melee legendary mod and has no limit on damage reflection.

**Stealth Boy**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Stealth Boy
- **Effect** : -
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : Activates a stealth field when crouching, making it harder for enemies to detect you. Works like the Chameleon effect but drains AP while active.

**Tesla Coils**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Tesla Coils
- **Effect** : Deals 5 Energy damage per second to nearby enemies
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Continuously deals 5 Energy damage per second to enemies near you. The damage remains active as long as enemies stay in range, with no cooldown.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

__Legs__

**No Misc Mod**

- **Plan** : Known by default
- **Effect** : -
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : N/A
- **Description** : This is the default legs mod with no added effects or modifications. It provides standard protection but no bonuses.

**Calibrated Shocks**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Calibrated Shocks
- **Effect** : +50 Carry Weight per leg
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Increases your carry weight by 50 pounds per leg. If equipped on both legs, it stacks, providing a total of +100 carry weight.

**Cooling Vent**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Cooling Vent
- **Effect** : Fusion Cores drain 5% slower
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Reduces the drain rate of your Fusion Cores by 5%, making them last longer. It stacks with the Power User perk, which further increases the duration of your Fusion Cores.

**Elastic Servos**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Elastic Servos
- **Effect** : Increases jump height by 50%
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Boosts your jump height by 50%.

**Kinetic Servos**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Kinetic Servos
- **Effect** : +1 AP regeneration per second when moving
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Restores 1% Action Points (AP) per second while moving for each leg equipped with Kinetic Servos. If both legs are equipped, it stacks, providing a total of 2% AP regeneration per second.

**Optimized Servos**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Optimized Servos
- **Effect** : -20% sprint AP cost
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Reduces the Action Points (AP) required for sprinting by 20%, allowing for longer sprints. Works with the Endurance stat, which reduces AP drain by 5% per point of Endurance. For example, with 5 Endurance and this mod, sprinting AP drain is reduced by a total of 45%.

**Overdrive Servos**

- **Plan** : Vulcan Overdrive Servos
- **Effect** : +10% sprint speed, +25% AP cost for sprinting
- **Stacks with similar perks and mods** : Yes
- **Description** : Increases sprint speed by 10% but increases sprinting AP cost by 25%. This mod works with other perks that boost sprint speed or reduce AP drain but may cause you to deplete AP faster.
